shot.title: 婚礼前：等她扶正胸花
shot.start_end_and_action: Medium smartphone view in the sheltered preparation arcade along the back of the wedding courtyard at warm dusk. The adult protagonist, around twenty-eight, wears a dark suit and white shirt, with the approved adult face. The bride is the same girl grown older, in a simple white wedding dress and low black hair bun. He finishes straightening one shirt cuff and notices his slightly tilted boutonniere. She steps half a pace toward him and lifts her right hand toward the flower. Warm lamps and the courtyard opening stay visible behind them. Friend films from their front-left at chest height. End before she touches the flower.
